title.en: Festival customs, safety and living together (additional, not in the textbook)

text.en: Rishi told his cousins how in his place they celebrate spring and place buransh flowers on the doors of houses.

Each place has its own customs for festivals, such as making rangoli, lighting lamps or placing flowers at doors.
Rishi shares his spring festival with his cousins, and they share the Kashmiri tulip festival.
We learn about each other's customs by sharing.
Road safety is important while going to festivals. Look at signboards like No Parking, School Ahead and Men at Work.
Wear a helmet on a bicycle? Cross roads at zebra crossings and follow traffic rules.
Living together in peace is the best part of any festival.
